slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第12章气血若恒星，元神可照星
“以前天下武道，以我大伏为最。”
幽静的小院中，秋风又起，卷起几片从院外梧桐上落下的树叶。
石桌前，青玥将那盛着桃花酥的檀盒放在桌上，又为几人端茶。
盛姿则与陆景相对而坐，继续道：“只是这数十年来，天下强人辈出，有鹿潭负剑儒生剑气一去三千里，斩得天下一场雪；也有烛星山邪道宗封妖敕魔，立起一座长生观，再加上北秦国力日趋强盛，屡次犯边，天下已经不再是大伏一家独大。”
盛姿提及那天下强者的时候，脸上明显还带着许多敬仰和羡慕。
陆景神色平常，但是心里却很是惊讶。
“剑气一去三千里……封妖敕魔……”
尽管因为大明王焱天大圣观想法，因为之前突兀出现在原身灵魂，让陆景心中已经有所准备。
可是亲耳听盛姿道出这些光怪陆离，让人他有些怀疑这世界的种种是否只是一场梦。
“时至如今，北秦国力已经与我大伏相差无几，北秦武道气血浩瀚，如同一轮轮熔炉，浩浩荡摧枯拉朽，论及武道，我大伏已然敌不过北秦了。”
盛姿说到这里，陆景不由想起陆府如今的处境。
“我曾听钟夫人说过，神霄伯府在这两百年时间里，逐渐落寞，不在于陆府子弟不争气，而是在于这两百年来，大伏威压天下，无人敢与大伏动武。”
“久而久之，像是陆府这样的武勋世家也就逐渐不再那般重要，逐渐没落——直至北秦突然露出獠牙。”
陆景思绪及此，不由道：“入则无法家拂士，出则无敌国外患者，国恒亡！现在大伏所面对的就是这一困境。”
盛姿侧头回味一番陆景的话，又结合当下大伏的处境，只觉得十分有道理。
陆景却又好奇问道：“天下武道既然已经不再以大伏为长，那大伏便是一只年老的瘦狮，总归是……”
他不曾继续说下去，有些话在这样的时代，不可轻易出口。
盛姿倒是有些惊奇，对陆景道：“景公子，你年龄以及十六有余，对于实事为何这般陌生？”
“我在陆府中地位特殊，不曾有教习先生，也不曾有司教嬷嬷，平日里去藏书阁也只可借阅一些儒学典籍，那些典籍都不曾涉及时局。”

陆景气度不变，没有丝毫窘迫，脸上还有几分微笑：“倒是让盛府小姐见笑了。”
盛姿见陆景毫不避讳本应令他难堪的事，心中越发好奇起来。
“这陆景只有十六岁，但却似乎看透世间的冷暖，褪去自身无用的愤懑……这样的心性可真是难得。”
她心中对于陆景的评价又高了许多。
一旁的陆漪原本听盛姿和陆景交谈，本来就百无聊赖。
又听到陆景的问题答案正好是自己所知，便抚掌取笑道：“陆景，你连我大伏强项都不知晓？”
“我大伏富庶，兵强马壮，三十万大伏虎贲仍然是天下第一。”
“而且大伏武夫稍弱，可元神修士却要比北秦更多更强，他们化真、持神火、元神照星，一念飞天，一念入地，一念元神横渡雷劫，裂山分河，论及元神修士的力量，也仍是大伏强过北秦。”
陆漪脸上带着自得之色，眼睛微微眯起，如同两轮弯月。
元神修士？
陆景眼中迸发出闪亮的光芒，再度对盛姿道：“请小姐赐教。”
这时的盛姿站起身来，解下腰间的青色长鞭，手腕一抖。
顿时，原本那独具美感的青色长鞭便犹如一条狞恶大蟒，朝着地上咬去！
一声脆响，青色长鞭落于地上的灰石。
陆景瞳孔微缩……那灰石应声裂开了一道极深的裂缝！
“不，不是裂缝，是那长鞭直落而下，强大的力量嵌入了石头，硬生生挤压出了一条看似裂缝的……深痕！”
陆景深吸一口气，一动不动的注视着那一块灰石。
“这便是武道之威。”
盛姿一击既出，慢条斯理的整理着手中的长鞭：“天下武夫踏入武道，先要铸造自身骨骼，增长自身的气血，要将自己的筋膜肉骨铸成一座大熔炉。
这三重境界被称之为【铸骨】、【气血】、【熔炉】三重境界，修成熔炉之境，肌肉饱满、身体迅捷，皮肉结实，力可以扛鼎，举起你陆府门口的石狮也不在话下。”

盛姿说话间，纤手放在石桌边缘，看似十分平常的推了推。
那沉重的实心石桌，竟然被盛姿这么一个窈窕女子推出尺余距离，几乎挨上了陆景的胸膛。
这时的陆景再也掩饰不住自己的惊讶，微微张了张嘴！
方才的景象简直匪夷所思。
“这便是武道小三境，是武道修士最早遇到的三个大关，修成熔炉之后，便可以以熔炉为核，熬练自己的内脏，熬练出自己的雪山；引元气入体，以元气熬练自身的肉体气血如大日高照，如日中天，其后再炼铸大脑、心脏中的乾、坤二穴，成就先天！
这几重境界分别是【雪山】、【大阳】、【先天】，此乃武道中三境……能修行到中三境俱都是一等一的武道娇子，我也十分羡慕这样的人物。”
盛姿眼里清清楚楚流露出艳羡之色。
陆景则在心中低声重复：“【铸骨、气血、熔炉、雪山、大阳、先天】，武道前六关……”
他真想要询问其它的三大境。
盛姿继续道：“后续三境，太过高远，其中的玄奇、神妙已经不是我们能够想象，我也只知那三境中的前两境名为【神相】、【天府】二境，个中细节我也没有多少了解，甚至第九境的名讳许多典籍里也没有记载。”
她语气中带着许多憧憬：“登临大三关，大约便是活着的仙神，气血旺盛如若恒星，不灭不朽，不可不敬。”
陆景眼神清亮，没有多言，只是细心倾听。
盛姿感慨一阵，又想起炼神一事：“我修武道，对于炼神倒是并不太了解，只知道我朝里的儒生、道佛两门中有许多元神修士，他们的元神受他们意志驱使，十分强大。
境界同样分为【感应、出窍、浮空、日照、化真、神火】等等九境。”
“景公子，伱是想要炼神，还是想要练武？”

Chapter 12 Qi and blood are like stars, and the soul can shine like stars
"In the past, I was the best martial artist in the world."
In the quiet courtyard, the autumn wind picked up again, picking up a few leaves that had fallen from the sycamore trees outside the courtyard.
In front of the stone table, Qing Yue placed the sandalwood box containing peach blossom cakes on the table and served tea to several people.
Sheng Zi sat opposite Lu Jing and continued: "It's just that in the past few decades, strong men have emerged in the world. There are Lutan Sword-bearing Confucian scholars who traveled three thousand miles with their sword energy and killed the whole world; there are also Zhuxing Mountain Evil Dao Sect who conferred demons and edicts on demons and erected a Temple of Immortality. In addition, Northern Qin's national power has become increasingly powerful and has repeatedly violated borders. Dafu's family is no longer the only one in the world."
When Shengzi mentioned the powerful people in the world, there was obviously a lot of admiration and envy on her face.
Lu Jing looked normal, but he was very surprised in his heart.
"The sword energy travels three thousand miles...Sealing the demon and commanding the demon..."
Although because of the idea of the Great Sage Yantian of the Ming Dynasty, Lu Jing was already prepared because of the sudden appearance of his original soul.
But hearing Sheng Zi say these strange things with his own ears made him wonder if everything in this world was just a dream.
"Today, the national power of Northern Qin is almost the same as that of Dafu. The martial arts of Northern Qin are vast and powerful, like a furnace. They are so vast and powerful that they can destroy everything. When it comes to martial arts, I, Dafu, can no longer compete with Northern Qin."
When Sheng Zi said this, Lu Jing couldn't help but think of the current situation of the Lu family.
"I once heard Mrs. Zhong say that the Shenxiao Mansion has gradually fallen into desolation in the past two hundred years, not because the children of the Lu Mansion have failed to live up to their expectations, but because in the past two hundred years, Dafu has been so coercive that no one dares to use force against Dafu."
"Over time, martial arts families like the Lu family gradually became less important and gradually declined - until Northern Qin suddenly showed its fangs."
When Lu Jing was thinking about this, he couldn't help but say: "If you go in, you will be helpless, and if you go out, you will be invincible to foreign patients, and the country will be destroyed! This is the dilemma that Dafu is facing now."
Shengzi turned her head to reflect on Lu Jing's words, and considering Dafu's current situation, she felt that it made perfect sense.
Lu Jing asked curiously: "Since Dafu is no longer the leader in martial arts in the world, then Dafu is an old and thin lion, after all..."
He did not continue to speak. Some words should not be spoken easily in such an era.
Sheng Zi was a little surprised and said to Lu Jing: "Mr. Jing, you are more than sixteen years old, why are you so unfamiliar with reality?"
"I have a special status in the Lu family. I have never had a tutor or a nanny. On weekdays, I can only borrow some Confucian classics when I go to the library. Those classics do not involve the current situation."
Lu Jing's demeanor remained unchanged, without any embarrassment, and there was still a bit of a smile on his face: "It made Miss Shengfu laugh."
Sheng Zi became more and more curious when she saw that Lu Jing did not shy away from things that should have embarrassed him.
"This Lu Jing is only sixteen years old, but he seems to have seen through the warmth and coldness of the world, and has shed his useless anger... Such a character is really rare."
Her evaluation of Lu Jing was much higher.
Lu Yi, who was on the side, was bored listening to the conversation between Sheng Zi and Lu Jing.
When he heard that the answer to Lu Jing's question was exactly what he knew, he put his hands on his hands and teased: "Lu Jing, you don't even know my strengths?"
"I am rich and powerful, my army is strong and my horses are strong, and my 300,000 powerful tigers and warriors are still the best in the world."
"Furthermore, the Dafu warriors are slightly weaker, but the Yuanshen monks are more powerful than those in Northern Qin. They transform into reality, hold divine fire, and shine on the stars with one thought. They fly to the sky with one thought and sink to the ground with one thought. They cross thunder tribulations with one thought and split mountains and rivers. When it comes to the power of the Yuanshen monks, Dafu is still stronger than Northern Qin."
Lu Yi had a complacent look on his face, and his eyes narrowed slightly, like two crescent moons.
Yuanshen monk?
Lu Jing's eyes burst out with sparkling light, and he said to Sheng Zi again: "Miss, please give me some advice."
At this time, Shengzi stood up, took off the green whip from his waist, and flicked his wrist.
Suddenly, the originally beautiful blue whip was like a ferocious python, biting towards the ground!
With a crisp sound, the long green whip fell onto the gray stone on the ground.
Lu Jing's pupils shrank... The gray stone cracked with a deep crack!
"No, it's not a crack, it's the long whip that fell straight down. The powerful force embedded itself in the stone, and squeezed out a deep mark that looked like a crack!"
Lu Jing took a deep breath and stared at the gray stone motionlessly.
"This is the power of martial arts."
Shengzi struck out with one strike, and slowly adjusted the long whip in his hand: "When martial artists in the world enter the martial arts, they must first cast their own bones, increase their own qi and blood, and build their own fascia, flesh and bones into a big melting pot.
These three realms are called the three realms of [Bone Casting], [Qi and Blood], and [Melting Furnace]. The realm of the furnace is full of muscles, fast body, strong skin and flesh, strong enough to carry a cauldron, and it is no problem to lift the stone lion at the entrance of your Lu Mansion. "
As Shengzi spoke, she placed her slender hand on the edge of the stone table and pushed it in a seemingly normal way.
The heavy solid stone table was pushed a few feet away by such a slim woman as Sheng Zi, and almost touched Lu Jing's chest.
At this time, Lu Jing could no longer hide his surprise and opened his mouth slightly!
The scene just now was simply unbelievable.
"These are the three realms of the martial arts. They are the first three stages that a martial arts monk encounters. After building the furnace, you can use the furnace as the core to temper your internal organs and create your own snow mountain. You can introduce the vitality into the body and use the vitality to temper your body and blood like the sun shining high in the sky. Then you can refine the Qian and Kun points in the brain and heart to achieve innateness!
These realms are [Snow Mountain], [Dayang], and [Xiantian]. These are the three middle realms of martial arts... Those who can practice to the middle three realms are all top-notch martial arts sweethearts. I also envy such a person. "
Shengzi's eyes clearly showed envy.
Lu Jingze repeated in a low voice in his heart: "[Forged Bone, Qi and Blood, Furnace, Snow Mountain, Dayang, Xiantian], the first six levels of martial arts..."
He really wanted to ask about the other three realms.
Shengzi continued: "The next three realms are too lofty, and the mysteries and wonders in them are beyond our imagination. I only know that the first two realms among the three realms are called [Divine Appearance] and [Heavenly Mansion]. I don't know much about the details. Even the name of the ninth realm is not recorded in many classics."
There was a lot of longing in her tone: "When you reach the Great Third Pass, you are probably a living immortal god. His vitality and blood are as strong as stars. He is immortal and immortal. You must not disrespect him."
Lu Jing's eyes were clear, he didn't say much, he just listened carefully.
Sheng Zi sighed with emotion, then thought of the matter of refining gods: "I practice martial arts, but I don't know much about refining gods. I only know that there are many soul monks among the Confucian, Taoist and Buddhist sects in my court. Their souls are driven by their will and are very powerful.
The realm is also divided into nine realms such as [induction, out-of-body, floating, sunshine, transformation, and divine fire]. "
"Mr. Jing, do you want to practice god training or martial arts?"
